description: Call this for historical Buying Gauge scores, not the live score (use get_buying_gauge for that). Returns daily date, 0-100 score, and tier points, oldest first. The days argument snaps to 30, 90, 180 or 365 (default 90). The gauge is Galaxy Mind's composite opinion, not investment advice.

days.description: Lookback window in days · snapped to the nearest supported window (30, 90, 180, 365); defaults to 90

name: get_gauge_history
